retrievalProfile.description: A three-tiered vertical composition featuring a central glacial landscape photograph sandwiched between dark, textured borders containing centered serif typography and celestial icons.
triggerTerms: stacked serif typography on dark texture
ethereal ice blue and dark charcoal palette

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical triptych layout where a bright, wide-angle photograph of figures in a glacial setting is framed by two dark, grainy textured bands. The top band houses multi-level centered serif text with a metallic gradient, while the bottom band features a horizontal row of celestial moon phase icons.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stacking of three distinct horizontal zones
Contrast between the bright blue/white center and dark charcoal outer bands
Symmetrical centering of subjects and typography
Repetition of circular motifs in the footer icons
coreInvariants: Horizontal division into three distinct panels
Centered vertical axis for all subjects and text
Grainy, film-like texture across all elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figures are vertically stacked in the middle of the center panel, occupying approximately one-third of the horizontal width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, top-level display text in the upper dark band.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down vertical flow from the large title, through the subtitle, into the central figures, ending at the lunar icons.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the dark bands focuses attention on the central text and the expansive glacial horizon.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal/black textured background in outer bands.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Icy blue and white in the central landscape photograph.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm gold and copper metallic gradients in the display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark borders and the bright, high-key central image.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thicks and thins
characterSpecificRedesigns: Punctuation marks scaled to match cap height in display line
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hierarchical stacking of a bold Didone for the primary title with a lighter Old Style serif for secondary information.
graphicDevices: Horizontal row of lunar phase icons in the footer

avoid: Solid flat colors for display text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Suitable for the secondary stacked text due to its readability and classic feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical triptych. The top and bottom sections are dark charcoal with a heavy film grain texture. The middle section is a wide-angle photograph of a bright blue glacial lagoon with icebergs and two figures centered vertically.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered serif text in the top section using a metallic gold gradient for the first line and a solid warm beige for the following lines. Add a horizontal row of small blue lunar phase icons across the bottom section.

verificationChecks: Is the composition divided into three clear horizontal bands?
Is all text and the main subject centered horizontally?
Does the top line of text have a metallic gradient effect?
Are there lunar icons in the bottom band?

adjustableVariables: Specific lunar phases shown in the footer
mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names or album titles
Do not replicate specific brand logos
Ensure the figures in the center are generic representations

mustAchieve: Consistent film grain texture across the entire image

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly centered.
Verify the three-panel structure is distinct.
Ensure the metallic effect on the display text is visible.
Confirm the presence of the footer icons.
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical Triptych + Dark Textured Borders + Centered Serif Typography + Glacial Centerpiece
